# TheRundown Documentation MCP

Official public documentation MCP: https://docs.therundown.io/mcp

Scope: search published TheRundown Product API documentation, schemas,
authentication guidance, billing, and integration examples. It does not return
live odds or scores. Do not send customer API keys to the documentation server.

Documentation guide: https://docs.therundown.io/documentation-mcp
OpenAPI: https://docs.therundown.io/openapi.yaml
API documentation index: https://docs.therundown.io/llms.txt

The separate official local Data MCP is https://github.com/TheRundown/data-mcp.
It is a local stdio server with customer-managed Product API access; it is not
a hosted data MCP endpoint.
